spans.s:
ra‿udara, a. having an r within;
 m. 🞄the Cakravāka bird (Anas Casarca).
ród-as, n. du. heaven and earth: 🞄(-aḥ) -kuhara, m., (-o) -randhra, n. cavity 🞄between heaven and earth.

ródas-ī, f. du. heaven and earth;
 🞄-ī́, f. N. of the wife of Rudra and companion 🞄of the Maruts, lightning.
rod-itavya, fp. n. one should weep.
